summary: Tested Customer Stock Dashboard new 'Table by distributor' view (backend + frontend). Backend endpoint now correctly returns distributor_id, distributor_name ('Brian' for seed accounts, 'Unassigned' otherwise) and brand_group_names per tile. Frontend tabs (csd-view-tabs / csd-view-tiles / csd-view-table) work, default = Tiles, table hides tiles & groups sections and shows cst-table with all 24 customers grouped by distributor. Interactions, quick find, account filter, localStorage persistence, responsive at 390 all pass. One bug: cst-dist-inhand-brian double-counts shared SKUs.

ui_bugs.issue: cst-dist-inhand-{key} sums row.stock_crates naively so shared SKUs are counted once per group member. Brian shows 202 cr but spec requires shared SKU counted ONCE (expected 102 cr = 202 − 5×20). cst-dist-expected-brian likely affected too if group expected is duplicated. Fix requires deduping shared child_sku_id contributions across rows before summing.

action_items: In CustomerStockTable.jsx DistributorBlock, dedupe shared child SKUs when computing inHand/expected totals. Approach: iterate rows and reduce over a Map keyed by child_sku_id, taking each shared SKU's stock/expected exactly once. Backend tile already lists child_skus[].shared and stock_crates per SKU, so aggregate at SKU-level rather than account-level for group members sharing the same SKU.
critical_code_review_comments: Quick find in table view: filter narrows rows but distributor header rows still render even when zero children remain in that block (e.g., 'Seed G' shows 5 distributor headers, only 1 has a matching row). Consider hiding empty blocks or showing zero-count state.
DistributorBlock header uses colSpan={4} for the name cell but table has 9 columns and header only aligns 6 subcells (inhand/expected + colSpan=3). Works but is brittle.
Backend `_build()` distributor resolution correctly prefers latest delivery, then assignment, then 'Unassigned' — good.
No data-testid on the row-level city/account_code subtext (minor).
